context:
Goal: no reviewed PR waits, and every found gap gets a fix (owner, 13:20 CST Nov 7).
Problem (rule): during the hold, only the lanes that land the fixes and your own asks start. The coordinator has read "the fixes" two ways. At 23:07 and 23:09 CST Nov 7 (steps feedback-same-anywhere and ci-scope-dynamic-paths), it read them as fixes that unblock a merge. Since then it has started lanes for gap fixes that block no merge, such as report-guard-role-default-model at 04:42 CST Nov 8. The hold is your ruling, so its scope needs your word.
Based on (ruling): item 384 (your chat, 21:42 CST Nov 7): new lanes wait, and the lanes that make the idle-PR, archive and drain fixes land still start.
Based on (ruling): your words at 13:20 CST Nov 7: a found gap gets a fix, not a note.
Based on (ruling): item 386 b (22:28 CST Nov 7): a lane's findings ride in its own PR, so a gap a lane found starts no new lane.
Departs from: main, which has no record of which lanes the hold lets start — adds one reading to record lane-inflow-hold.
Meanwhile: a gap a lane found rides in that lane. The coordinator starts new lanes only for your asks and for fixes that unblock a merge until you answer.

options.gain: Gaps close as they are found.
options.how: Record lane-inflow-hold says: during the hold, a lane may start for your own asks and for any fix for a found gap. Other new work waits.
options.label: Every fix for a found gap may start a lane
options.lose: More lanes run at once, and the queue of reviewed PRs that the hold protects grows.

options.gain: The queue of reviewed PRs drains first.
options.how: Record lane-inflow-hold says: during the hold, a lane may start for your own asks and for a fix that unblocks a merge or a queued PR. Other gap fixes wait as todo steps, or ride in the lane that found them.
options.label: Only a fix that unblocks a merge or a queued PR starts a lane
options.lose: Gaps that block no merge stay open longer.

ref: Items 384 and 387; owner 13:20 CST Nov 7; coordinator record lane-inflow-hold (PR #1768); step pr-backlog-clear
reply: You picked a (06:11 CST Nov 8): during the hold on new lanes, a lane may start for your own asks and for any fix for a found gap; other new work waits. Routed to the coordinator; home: record lane-inflow-hold (PR #1768) and step pr-backlog-clear. Closed 06:14 CST Nov 8.
short: Hold: which gap fixes start a lane
title: During the hold on new lanes, may every fix for a found gap start a lane, or only a fix that unblocks a merge?
